faqs.q: How many partners are required to register an LLP?
faqs.a: A minimum of two partners is required for LLP incorporation in India. There is no upper limit on the number of partners.

faqs.q: Can an LLP raise investment from venture capital firms?
faqs.a: Most venture capital investors prefer investing in private limited companies because they can issue equity shares. LLPs are generally not the preferred structure for venture funding.

faqs.q: Is an LLP better than a partnership firm?
faqs.a: An LLP provides limited liability protection, a separate legal identity, and stronger legal recognition compared to a traditional partnership firm.

faqs.q: How long does LLP incorporation take?
faqs.a: Most LLP registrations are completed within 7–10 business days, subject to document verification and MCA processing timelines.

faqs.q: Is an LLP required to file annual compliance returns?
faqs.a: Yes. LLPs must comply with annual filing and statutory obligations under applicable laws.
